(1) In scripts/verify.browser.test.ts (lines 1-160), every case awaits runVerify, which resolves only on the child process&#39;s &#39;close&#39; event (lines 34-42). The assertions run on the exit code and output after that. portClosed is an awaited connect/error probe that runs after the process has exited. There are exactly three such files, and each is quoted here in full. None of them calls setTimeout, waitForTimeout, a sleep, or reads an element count as if that call had waited. (1) In scripts/verify.browser.test.ts (lines 1-160), every case awaits runVerify, which resolves only on the child process&#39;s &#39;close&#39; event (lines 34-42). The assertions run on the exit code and output after that. portClosed is an awaited connect/error probe that runs after the process has exited. (2) In scripts/inspect-presentation.browser.test.ts (lines 1-90), every case awaits runInspect, which also resolves on &#39;close&#39; (lines 14-22). The test then reads the screenshots and output. (3) In skills/presentation/bootstrap.browser.test.ts (lines 1-82), the test uses spawnSync, which blocks until the process exits, and asserts only afterwards. These tests drive the browser through the scripts they spawn, and those scripts wait on observable state. scripts/verify.mjs:143-155 and scripts/inspect-presentation.mjs:351-362 press ArrowRight and then re-read data-step-index in a deadline-bounded polling loop until it equals the expected step. If it never does, verify records a failure and inspect throws. Judges A and B are borne out. Judge C&#39;s reason does not decide the criterion. The `--settle 800` case (inspect-presentation.browser.test.ts:48-60) does not have the test sleep and then assert. The test awaits process close and checks that the helper&#39;s configurable settle interval was honoured. Inside the helper, that settle (inspect-presentation.mjs:363) runs only after the polling loop has confirmed the step index, so it does not replace waiting for state. The guidance also treats settle delays as validator noise.","evidence":["vitest.browser.config.ts:7 includes only `{src,scripts,skills}/**/*.browser.test.ts`.
